Inkay

Dark Psychic

Kalos · Generation 6

Inkay is a Dark/Psychic-type Revolving Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 3.5 kg. It evolves into Malamar. Its highest base stat is Attack (54), with a base stat total of 288.
